1.0.0|CTR Generator: First working version of the CTR generator desktop app.
1.0.1|CTR Generator: Consumables and equipment now appear as their own lines on the pricing page.
1.0.1|App-wide / Infrastructure: App and installer now share one version number, so they cannot disagree.
1.0.2|CTR Generator: AZN pricing now calculated by working hours instead of days.
1.0.3|CTR Generator: Equipment priced from a separate USD price list; source files chosen separately (AZN / SAGE / USD); consumable rechargeability read from SAGE; one USD error fixed.
1.0.4|CTR Tracker: New CTR Tracker: reads generated CTRs and writes them into the tracker automatically, with cost breakdown, location and currency handled, and an optional backup.
1.0.5|MR vs CTR Comparator: Fixed footer/signature rows being wrongly counted as items in comparisons.
1.0.6|CTR Tracker: Tracker can now find the summary row in larger files.
1.0.7|CTR Generator: Users can save their own item descriptions (renames); warning for empty Contract No; PDF export now hides unused rows and fits one page wide.
1.0.8|CTR Generator: Saved description renames now also depend on stock code, so similar items no longer clash.
1.0.9|CTR Generator: CTR Request extras now flow into the CTR: transport becomes Third Party Activities, scaffold becomes a USD equipment line, request comments are carried over. Many layout and print fixes for AZN/USD.
1.0.9|CTR Tracker: Tracker recognises Onshore/Offshore activity types more reliably.
1.0.10|MR vs CTR Comparator: Combined View groups matches by stock code with the CTR-MR difference; automatic price/rechargeable check; comparisons can be saved and loaded.
1.0.10|CTR Generator: Manpower comment now states the shift and shift type.
1.0.10|CTR Tracker: Tracker adds revisions as separate rows (inserted via Excel), checks currency, picks the project code from the client, and fixes several batch-writing errors.
1.0.11|MR vs CTR Comparator: Easier results screen: hide/maximize toggles, search when loading a saved comparison, ability to add more files to a loaded comparison.
1.0.12|CTR Generator: Fixed 'nan' in Third Party totals and manual manpower quantities being lost; fewer redundant recalculations.
1.0.12|MR vs CTR Comparator: Loading a corrupted saved comparison now fails safely.
1.0.12|CTR Tracker: Tracker backup turned on by default; fixes for the packaged .exe.
1.0.13|CTR Tracker: Tracker gets a required Job Type dropdown, duplicate-CTR detection in a batch, and fixes to revision row insertion.
1.0.13|MR vs CTR Comparator: Document name columns in Combined View, per-file remove button, faster table scans, and stale-preview fixes.
1.0.13|App-wide / Infrastructure: Fixed black tooltips, logging of hidden errors, project folder renamed to ctr_tools, unused dependency removed.
1.0.13|CTR Generator: Saved aliases/renames are written only when something actually changed.
1.0.14|MR vs CTR Comparator: Combined View shows both MR and CTR descriptions; items built from several documents are highlighted; mismatch navigation fixed.
1.0.14|CTR Generator: USD CTR totals and costs corrected (several totals were too low); AZN gets a dedicated Comments box; fonts, currency symbols and blank-section display fixed.
1.0.14|App-wide / Infrastructure: Removed an outdated, non-working test folder.
1.0.15|MR vs CTR Comparator: Option to include the Socar-Cape cover sheet, remove single files, hide columns by right-click, toolbar moved above results.
1.0.16|CTR Tracker: Fixed a USD value showing as a date; every tracker write is now a separate revision; revisions stay in correct order.
1.0.17|CTR Generator: AZN totals now include Contingency and follow the Third Party duration; app checks the template layout before writing.
1.0.17|CTR Tracker: Clear messages when the tracker file is locked or Excel closes during a write.
1.0.18|App-wide / Infrastructure: New F12 Inspector for diagnosis (logs, charts, one-file Snapshot report) and a Stop option for long tasks.
1.0.18|CTR Generator: Much faster: Generator table fills in 0.5 s instead of 35 s; CTR Request no longer loads the huge SAGE sheet.
1.0.18|MR vs CTR Comparator: Comparator tables 3-4x faster and use less memory.
1.0.18|CTR Tracker: Loading fields from a CTR file no longer freezes the screen.
1.0.19|CTR Generator: Nothing is guessed any more: missing values stay blank and red, manpower rates come from a chosen Encoding (Onshore and Offshore never mixed), and rows stay neutral until the files are loaded. Also a cost statistics box with Excel export, a 'Go to value' button and drop-downs. Still open: how empty transport lines are handled and allowance encodings.
1.0.19|MR vs CTR Comparator: New document filter for the result tabs, a Compare Values button in the Combined View, numbers sort as numbers, and a Statistics tab with rechargeable vs non-rechargeable cost totals.
1.0.19|App-wide / Infrastructure: New Settings window, Ctrl+F search and full-text hover in every table, a smaller mouse pointer under WSL, and IT permission granted. Still to do on Windows: build the app, compile the installer and test that it installs over the old version.
1.0.20|App-wide / Infrastructure: Saved offscreen tests, user data kept out of git, one task-log backup per release, and testing the app with the commercial assistant.
1.0.20|Proposals / Documents: Short and long Word proposals, plus contract terms and pricebooks for each company.
1.0.20|CTR Generator: Transport lines with a quantity of 0 or less are hidden in the CTR, Reset presets no longer brings back a developer preset, Settings can restore a backup of aliases, renames or presets, and the CTR Request look is done; notes per section and the talk about a new request form are still open.
1.0.20|MR vs CTR Comparator: A Disparities button (red exclamation mark) lists Stock Codes whose rechargeability in the documents contradicts SAGE; those items are left out of the statistics.
